# TheoMedia

> Independent web design and digital product studio serving the United Kingdom and Ireland.

TheoMedia designs and engineers bespoke websites, ecommerce experiences, booking engines and custom business software. Founder-led. 100% client-owned source code. No templates. No platform lock-in.

## Contact

- Site: https://www.theomedia.co.uk
- Email: hello@theomedia.co.uk
- Phone / WhatsApp: +353 85 225 8004
- Markets: United Kingdom and Ireland
- Pricing: from £895 / €1,050 — https://www.theomedia.co.uk/pricing
